metrics.arm_Hv:
this file, `client --arm Hv`; PRIMARY): SR 50's tvp front end in front of Hp.
  - The env is SR 63's Hp env (s2fix3.client_main, run UNCHANGED: this client only wraps the env class it installs and the websocket
    client), wrapped once more by VEnv.  Hp's env sees the RAW observation: its OWLv2 perception, hold detector, gate rule, target
    registration and P are Hp's, byte for byte.
  - VEnv passes every observation the env returns through tv_frozen.Front (SR 50's front end, unchanged: ProprioHeld at sc_rv_lex's
    threshold, R2's role_paint with this scene's movables = the three mugs and two plates), stepped on the EXECUTED gripper command
    (Rec2's logged a6: P's command while P acts, the VLA's otherwise).  Object phase (no hold): every movable except the task's mug is
    painted magenta in both cameras; target phase (hold): every movable except the target plate.  The VLA receives only the painted
    observation; the detector and P never see it.
  - Masks: the SIMULATOR's entity maps (s2.SimSeg, as SR 50; PRIVILEGED: the learned segmenter has no mug class, SR 50).
  - Phrases (tvp): the prompt the VLA receives is "object: <the task's mug>" while the view detector is off and "target: <the target
    plate>" while it is on (s2_tasks PHRASE; SR 50's format).  It is the only change to the prompt.
  - While P acts the VLA's actions are discarded (Hp's rule), so the views matter only before the hand-over and after a P abort.
ARM Hv0 (SECONDARY, pi0.5 only): Hv without the phrases (SR 50's tv in front of Hp; prompt unchanged).
metrics.deviations_planned: Layout O only.  Client seed 7 and server seed 13 kept from SR 50-64 (state and branch seeds are new).  Hp runs SR 63's client unchanged; Hv / Hv0 run it unchanged inside a view wrapper (its side file's arm field reads Hp).  Views use simulator masks (privileged).  Hvp (OWLv2-perceived views) and GR00T are not run.  Hv0 added as a secondary pi0.5 arm (tv without phrases).  Depth and camera calibration stay privileged.  Ledger tree dirty (other agents' files).
metrics.information: Hv reads, beyond Hp, the SIMULATOR entity masks of the five movables in both cameras (PRIVILEGED, as SR 50's tv / tvp) and shows the VLA the role phrases built from the task's object and target (which Hp already reads).  The hand-over's perception (OWLv2 + rendered depth + camera calibration), hold detector, gate and P are Hp's, on the RAW observation.  The simulator oracle is logged, never fed.
metrics.labels: NEW states (LIBERO sampler on K1's BDDL, seeds 960000 + k, none equal to an SR 50-64 state), main k = 4-63 (60), branches seed_base 42000000 + 1000 k; layout O; tasks K1, K2, N1, N2; client seed 7, --bind track.  Models: frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY; pp_serve_purify --model pi05 --mode intact --comp= --seed 13) and frozen pi0 (SECONDARY; serve_guided --mode ours --seed 13, BACKBONE_CONFIG=pi0_libero).  Arms: I (s2.py client), Hp (SR 63's arm, s2fix3.py client --arm Hp, unchanged), Hv (SR 50's tvp front end, simulator masks, in front of Hp: s2fix5.py client --arm Hv), and on pi0.5 only Hv0 (SR 50's tv, no phrases, in front of Hp; SECONDARY).  Success = the BDDL goal.  Matrices [task, state].  Paired bootstrap over states, tasks fixed (s2.boot2_states, B = 2000, numpy default_rng(0); CI = 2.5 / 97.5).  Per model, registered labels: (V1) Hv - Hp on N2: VIEWS HELP iff lo > 0; VIEWS HURT iff hi < 0; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE.  (V2, SR 62's rule) dN = Hv - I on N1+N2, dK = Hv - I on K1+K2: FIX WORKS iff dN lo > 0 AND dK lo > -.05 (NON-INFERIOR at margin -.05); PARTIAL iff exactly one holds; FAILS iff neither.  (V3) BAR: MEETS BAR iff Hv's N1+N2 success >= .50 AND dN lo > 0 (SR 54's FIXED); else BELOW BAR.  PRIMARY: V1, V2, V3 on pi0.5.  SR 50's floor on every model: TESTABLE iff its I K1+K2 success >= .70 on these states; a NOT TESTABLE model's labels read NOT TESTABLE with the rule's outcome descriptive.  MECHANISM (registered read, descriptive label): on N2, the share of episodes whose FIRST detector onset holds the named (yellow-and-white) mug by the logged simulator rule (events[0].sim_held; an episode with no onset counts as not named), Hv vs Hp, with s2cue.boot_share CIs and the paired state-bootstrap difference; also the same share on K2, the share by the perceived held mug, and N2 success given a named / unnamed first hold.  SECONDARY: Hp's FIX label per model (SR 63 replication); Hv - Hp on N1+N2, K1+K2 and K2 (VIEWS GAIN iff lo > 0, VIEWS COST iff hi < 0, else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE); on pi0.5 V1-V3 for Hv0 and Hv - Hv0 on N2 and on K1+K2.  Descriptive: perception accuracy (SR 63's accuracy() on the Hp / Hv / Hv0 side files), front-end diagnostics (onsets, painted queries), final plate of each mug (s2fix2.describe), episode length.  C1: the reference planner (s2.plan_episode via s2cue3.ref_eps, unchanged) on the main states; MET iff its N1-N2 success >= .80.
metrics.prediction:
S2FIX5 predictions (SR 66), written 2026-11-15 after the code (experiments/s2fix5.py, s2fix5_roll.sh) and BEFORE any job of this
probe (states, smoke or main).  Nothing of this probe has been run.

Mechanism I expect: on N2 the views move pi0.5's first grasp to the named mug on about half the episodes (SR 50 tvp .533); those go
to P and succeed at about SR 54 htvp's .84.  On the other half the VLA holds the white mug under the target-phase view (only the
left plate unpainted, prompt "target: the left plate"); some of those later grasp the named mug and P places it, as under Hp.  On
K2 the views cost less than in SR 50 (.767 under tvp), because a hold of the named mug now goes to P; but the white-first episodes
under the target-phase view are a new risk.  N1 and K1 name the white mug, which the VLA grasps first anyway: little change there.
